logp.method_description: A shake-flask ultraviolet absorptive spectrophotometry method29 was used to determine the n-octanol/water (log Po/w) partition coefficients of the ruthenium complexes. First, a mixture of 50 mL n-octanol and 50 mL aqueous NaCl (0.9%, w/v) was left shaking at 37 °C for 48 h. The ruthenium complex standard solutions were prepared using the water phase or organic phase. Second, the ruthenium complex detection solutions (10 μM) were prepared with a mixed solvent containing 25 mL of n-octanol and 25 mL of aqueous NaCl (0.9%, w/v), and shaken for 48 h. Third, the concentrations of the ruthenium complexes in the water phase (Cw) and organic phase (Co) of the detecting solution were determined using ultraviolet spectrophotometry. The n-octanol/water partition coefficient (logP) was calculated by the following eqn (1). logP = lg(Co/Cw)
